text: A quarter-wave antenna for 2.4 GHz is approximately how long?
explanation: Wavelength is c/f = 12.5 cm, so a quarter wave is about 3.1 cm. At 900 MHz it is 8.3 cm — the whip on a car roof — and at 28 GHz it is 2.7 mm, which is what makes mmWave phased arrays with dozens of elements practical.
